scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted palette and polished card UI lift it above generic, but the bottom cluster is cropped in the rendered screenshot and the labels (g0, s0, root) are meaningless ID fragments with no typographic hierarchy between them.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct throughout — d3.scaleSqrt used for force node radii and sunburst radial scale, d3.pack/treemap/partition handle area proportionality natively, and key functions (d => d.data.id) ensure object constancy; only minor issue is bundle paths keyed by index rather than stable identity, which could corrupt constancy after data regeneration.
scores.stress_test_note: Properly uses RAF dirty-flag for force ticks, interrupt() before every transition, and slider-throttled bundle redraws; the only marginal concern is full data joins on every animation frame via d3.timer during layout transitions, which is intentional but expensive at 300 connections.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single morphing view keeps cognitive load manageable despite ~200 nodes and 300 bundled connections; circle-pack layout reads clearly with restrained 15%-opacity bundles and a clean 5-color grouping, but 7 switchable layout modes adds learning overhead and force/animation quality cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
